The median gap between visits across the studio’s whole ledger is 1 days and 85 per cent of gaps are a week or less. The tenth of the base that comes most produces 42 per cent of all attendance. Of 4,218 recorded first-timers, 19 per cent reached a third visit - the point at which a 2-for-1 intro pack member is genuinely returning. Most of what looks like churn at this studio is one early step that nobody currently owns.
